title: TradeFile
description: YAML frontmatter schema for one file under trades/<YYYY-MM-DD>-<PAIR>-<seq>.md. This single record serves as the Journal entry, the Edge Log entry, and (if flagged) a Mistake DB entry per SYSTEM-DESIGN.md section 8. The Markdown body below the frontmatter holds the full Decision Output (master spec section 23) and, once closed, the Post-Trade Review (section 26).

setup_type.description: e.g. Wyckoff Spring Type 2, Liquidity Sweep Reversal, Trend Continuation

rehearsal_mode.description: true if this trade record came from a MOCK-data rehearsal run, not a live decision. Rehearsal trades must never be counted in the consecutive-loss throttle or Edge Log win-rate rollups.

drill.description: true when this trade was a --drill rehearsal (docs/plans/2026-09-18-close-feature-gaps.md §0.11): a real order on the demo/testnet account placed to prove the signal→order→page path. Excluded from every rollup and from outcomes.ingest; never evidence of an edge.

confluence_score.description: DecisionAgent score; null for rules-only pilot trades (no confluence engine ran)

targets.description: LEGACY (pre-§17): bare target prices with no methodology, no lifecycle and no provenance. Kept because closed trades carry it and rewriting history would be worse; new records should carry `expectations` instead, which preserves the eight fields CLAUDE.md §17 requires. Never delete this field -- a legacy trade that silently lost its targets is a worse artifact than an honest legacy shape.

risk_pct.description: Fraction of equity risked on this trade (0.01 = 1%), capped by docs/architecture/risk-config.json max_risk_pct. NULL means the source did not record it -- only reachable for an ingested pilot log line that carried no risk_pct field. Nullable since 2026-09-17: scripts/journal.py used to substitute 0.005 there, writing a risk nobody took into the file the Edge Log, Mistake DB and every expectancy statistic read back. A visible null can be excluded from a risk-weighted breakdown; a fabricated 0.5% silently joins the sample as fact. Readers MUST skip nulls rather than coerce them to a default -- that coercion is the bug this type change exists to prevent.

position_size.description: base-asset units from RiskSkill; null until a position size has actually been approved (e.g. NO_TRADE/WAIT rehearsals)

is_mistake.description: set true so this record surfaces in the Mistake-DB rollup view

market.description: venue the trade was executed on; demo/testnet trades are excluded from nothing but labelled everywhere

source.description: who produced the record: /analyze pipeline, the rules-only demo pilot, a hand entry, or the pilot's CFD leg (real orders on the MT5 DEMO account through integrations/mt5/OrderBridge.mq5)

session.description: Session/killzone of the entry, derived from the entry time in the EXCHANGE-LOCAL clock for that date (DST-aware), not in UTC. GENERATED by scripts/sync-sessions.py from docs/architecture/sessions.json (model v2); do not hand-edit. The windows and the reasoning behind them are docs/architecture/session-model.md. `off` means inside no window, which includes every weekend timestamp for every instrument.

planned_rr.description: reward:risk at plan time (target1 vs stop)

pnl_usd.description: realised P&L in quote currency, fees included when known

slippage_bps.description: (actual fill - planned entry)/planned entry in basis points, signed against the trade

thesis.description: one paragraph: why this trade, in Wyckoff/ICT terms, with the facts it rested on

plan_vs_actual.description: what differed between the plan (entry/stop/target/size/timing) and what was executed

followed_plan.description: false whenever any rule of the plan was broken (early exit, moved stop, oversized, chased entry)

confidence.description: pre-trade confidence 1–5, recorded before the outcome is known

emotional_state.description: free text for the human trader (calm / FOMO / revenge / tired…); leave empty for pilot trades

strategy.description: pilot only (scripts/strategy-runner.py): which mechanical rule produced the trade; absent for every other source

htf_pass.description: pilot only: whether the 2H boundary filter (backtest config C) allowed the direction at signal time; logged either way so B vs C can be compared from the journal

screenshots.description: paths or URLs of chart captures at entry/exit

review_notes.description: post-trade review: what the market actually did vs the thesis

what_to_change.description: the single concrete change for next time (rule, filter, sizing, timing); feeds learning-agent

wyckoff_event.description: Structured Wyckoff event record (user decision 2026-09-10, knowledge/integrated/method.md section 7 decisions 5 and 6). The two classifications are kept in SEPARATE fields on purpose: knowledge/wyckoff/modern-tools.md section 8 states its type-1/2/3 taxonomy is author-specific and is NOT the classic event vocabulary. Do not collapse them.

phase.description: Wyckoff phase the event sits in (knowledge/wyckoff/advance.md sections 2.7-2.10)

event_class.description: classic event label from knowledge/wyckoff/advance.md sections 2.7-2.8. UT vs UA follows the book's phase-conditional naming rule (WA p8, knowledge/wyckoff/advance.md section 1.3): UT only in phan_phoi/tai_phan_phoi, UA only in tich_luy/tai_tich_luy.

volume_type.description: Spring/Upthrust type 1/2/3 by volume, knowledge/wyckoff/modern-tools.md sections 2.6-2.7. null when the event is not a Spring or Upthrust, or when the type could not be determined.

doi_nhan_tested.description: true only if the phase call survived the mislabelling tests at knowledge/wyckoff/advance.md section 2.11. false means the phase call is a hypothesis.

naming_conflict.description: set when the knowledge/wyckoff/advance.md event class and the knowledge/wyckoff/modern-tools.md volume type disagree; records both readings verbatim rather than resolving them.

contradictions.description: Contradictions raised during the analysis, persisted so LearningSkill/improve can count recurrences across trades (user decision 2026-09-10, knowledge/integrated/method.md section 7 decision 3). Mirrors the contradictions array in confluence-score.schema.json.

category.description: shakeout_vs_displacement is the unresolved case at knowledge/integrated/method.md section 4.5: a Shakeout with body closes beyond the boundary is bullish Wyckoff and bearish ICT displacement on the same candles. No source resolves it; the standing rule is to raise a Contradiction and log it here so the decision can later be made from outcomes rather than argument.

penalty.description: percentage points applied, negative; null if raised without a scoring penalty

outcome_side.description: filled in at review time (/review), not at entry. This is the field that eventually resolves knowledge/integrated/method.md section 7 decision 3.

setup_version.description: CLAUDE.md §14: the rule version of the setup that produced this trade (scripts/setup_version.py). `strategy` is the setup's NAME and is reused across rule changes -- rank-setups.py rewrites pilot-selection.json in place -- so the name alone cannot tie a closed trade to the rules it was taken under. Null for trades predating 2026-09-18 and for any path that did not record one.

expectations.description: CLAUDE.md §17 expectation records, written by scripts/expectation.py. Each is {original, status, history, id}: `original` is frozen at creation and never rewritten, `history` carries the lifecycle, and the actual path is compared against it rather than over it.
